messages:
Maya R.: Uploading the pen-test + vuln-scan artifacts requested by Acme's vendor risk team. Zip includes: full pen-test report (PDF), nessus_export.xml, nmap_full.txt, remediation-tracker.csv, per-issue evidence (screenshots/logs/pcap), and an attestation draft. S3: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/artifacts/acme_vendor_package_1790501234.zip
SHA256: 7e4b5c3a9d2f6a1b8c0d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4

SecurityBot: Automated scan summary (2026-03-18): Tools = Nessus Pro 10.5, nmap 7.93. Findings: 1 CRITICAL (CVE-2025-9999 on exposed bastion service), 4 HIGH, 7 MEDIUM, 2 LOW. remediation-tracker.csv includes CVE references, repro steps, and suggested mitigations. :clipboard:

Owen T.: Sales needs tracker to include owner, owning team, ETA (YYYY-MM-DD), change-request ID, and on-call contact. Also confirm whether we can provide a signed InfoSec attestation and a brief customer-facing summary.

Maya R.: Added those columns and updated the CSV in the zip. Sample rows below (full file in bundle):
```
issue_id,short_desc,severity,owner,team,eta,change_req,oncall
AC-CRIT-01,Exposed bastion service (CVE-2025-9999),CRITICAL,Owen T.,Infra Security,2026-03-20,CHG-8302,oncall@redwood.com
AC-H-12,Deprecated OpenSSL build,HIGH,Claire B.,Infra,2026-03-27,CHG-8303,oncall@redwood.com
AC-M-05,Missing CSP header,MEDIUM,Web Eng,Frontend,2026-03-25,CHG-8304,oncall@redwood.com
```

Claire B.: Notes on AC-CRIT-01: exposed service discovered on bastion due to an erroneous security group allowing 0.0.0.0/0 TCP 22 and a legacy management agent responding to SSH banner. Mitigation plan: 1) remove broad SG rule, 2) lock management CIDRs, 3) decommission legacy agent. I can execute rule change in the next maintenance window; ETA 2026-03-20 to include validation. Evidence filenames: AC-CRIT-01-banner.txt, AC-CRIT-01-sg-before.txt, AC-CRIT-01-sg-after.txt, AC-CRIT-01-verify-nmap.txt.

Maya R.: Attestation: we can produce an InfoSec-signed PDF addressed to "Acme Corp (security@acme.example)" that confirms the scope of the assessment and states that no customer PII was discovered in the exported artifacts. Draft included at /attestation/acme_attestation_draft_1790501234.pdf inside the zip. We will GPG-sign and add a PDF timestamp prior to sending.

Owen T.: Added verification commands and a short test checklist into the tracker so Acme can reproduce validation: e.g., `nmap -Pn -p22 <bastion-ip>` and `ssh -vvv <bastion-ip>`. Also included the exact apt/yum commands to patch OpenSSL and a snippet to verify CVE strings are absent.

Maya R.: Draft customer-facing summary for the outbound email: "Redwood completed an external penetration test and vulnerability scan covering your provisioned environment. One critical finding was identified and scheduled for immediate remediation; we have attached remediation owners, timelines, and supporting evidence, plus an InfoSec-signed attestation confirming no customer PII was found in our artifacts."

Claire B.: I'll attach post-change validation outputs to the evidence folder after the maintenance window and update the tracker. I'll also create CHG-8302 with rollback steps.

SecurityBot: Reminder: default retention for security artifacts = 90 days. If Legal requires extended retention for this customer, please open a retention ticket in #legal-retention.

Maya R.: Planning to send the bundle to Acme tomorrow 09:30 PT and commit the signed attestation then. We'll promise a 48-hour clarification SLA for follow-ups. Ping me in #sales if anything else. Closing thread unless objections.
